tuieditor.shortcut: Ctrl+G  edit the draft in your editor ($VISUAL or $EDITOR)
tuieditor.noEditor: No editor is set: set VISUAL or EDITOR (for example EDITOR=nano) and start the terminal again. The draft is unchanged.
tuieditor.notStarted: The editor named in VISUAL or EDITOR could not be started. The draft is unchanged.
tuieditor.exit: The editor ended with an error, so its changes were not taken. The draft is unchanged.
tuieditor.tooLarge: The text is larger than the editor can hand back. The draft is unchanged.
tuieditor.unsafe: The draft file was replaced by a link or by something that is not a file, so it was not read. The draft is unchanged.
tuieditor.failed: The editor could not be used. The draft is unchanged.
